admission.justification: A text bound alone loses complete evidence, filing alone can leak full payload into recipient context, and file-only delivery alone cannot retain the full waited reply; the independent limit, storage, input, pointer and reply obligations together provide recoverable evidence with bounded conversational context.

guarantee: For admitted successful shared-task role_message filing and delivery, wake/reply text is bounded without truncating complete submitted body or attachment files; recipients receive wake text and owned file/hash pointers rather than the full payload, and a supplied waited native reply is preserved completely beside the message while its returned text is bounded. Input/storage/native-send refusals retain their separately named outcomes; this does not certify live host/plugin consumption, role powers or acceptance.
title: Bounded wake context with complete recoverable message payloads
